app_level.why: Core equation is private. Several slots sit at the measured value. Koide is counted three times. G and ℓ_P are one leftover. Weinberg 3/8 is standard GUT running. Manifold sweep already failed.

app_level.name: public_producing_map_F
app_level.app_says: core DA equation is private / trade secret
app_level.why: P3 requires a public F and χ²_ext ≤ ε². A hidden equation is not a check.

app_level.name: manifold_lambda_ratio_is_cos_theta_W
app_level.app_says: 10 standard geometries, 0 match cos θ_W ≈ 0.878; highest Bolza 0.717
app_level.why: The app already recorded this as a DA prediction fail for every known exact-spectrum topology. A tuned torus aspect ratio is a fit, not a prediction (tuning trap).

app_level.name: gauge_couplings_should_not_meet
app_level.app_says: SM miss + no superpartners ⇒ topological unification
app_level.why: Non-convergence is only gauge3. Our screen already has SM fail and MSSM-class open as gauge3, fail as nature4. A miss is not a topology.

app_level.name: scenario_B_strengthening
app_level.why: Slogan. Collapse still requires a public F. Waveform has not collapsed.
